title: ADHD in women — Nadia, 38, and the ASRS-v1.1 screener
caption:
Called "scattered" since you were nine? In women, ADHD gets read as anxiety first.
Free 6-question screener: the WHO's ASRS-v1.1 (Kessler, 2005) — hand it to your doctor.
Send to her. Sound familiar?
www.aiforheratx.org

scenes.text: Nadia hears the same lines every year, and by now she half believes them.
Boys get diagnosed about *twice* as often as girls (CDC). Quiet daydreamers slip through.

scenes.text: Tonight: take the ASRS-v1.1, then list three childhood examples to hand your doctor.
phrases: Write 3 examples from childhood — old report cards count.
Walk 20 minutes tomorrow; WHO asks for 150 a week.
